'''Heiko Heßenkemper''' (born 11 January 1956), also spelled '''Heiko Hessenkemper''', is a German politician, until June 2021 for the [[Alternative for Germany]], and was member of the [[Bundestag]] from 2017 to 2021.

==Life and politics==
Heßenkemper was born 1956 in the West German town of [[Hamm, North Rhine-Westphalia|Hamm]] and studied [[physics]] at the [[Clausthal University of Technology]]. He became a [[professor]] in 1995.<ref name="bundestag">{{cite web|url=https://www.bundestag.de/abgeordnete/biografien/H/520348-520348|title=Deutscher Bundestag - Prof. Dr. Heiko Heßenkemper|website=bundestag.de|access-date=14 September 2019}}</ref>

Heßenkemper entered the AfD in 2014 and became a member of the bundestag after the [[2017 German federal election]]<ref name="abgeordnetenwatch">{{cite web|url=https://www.abgeordnetenwatch.de/profile/heiko-hessenkemper|title=abgeordnetenwatch.de &#124; Profil von Prof. Dr. Heiko Heßenkemper, AfD - Bundestag|website=abgeordnetenwatch.de|access-date=14 September 2019}}</ref>

Heßenkemper is considered to be part of the [[right-wing]] of the AfD.<ref name="zeit">{{cite news|url=https://www.zeit.de/politik/deutschland/2017-09/afd-kandidaten-bundestagswahl-abgeordnete|title=AfD-Abgeordnete: Rechts bis extrem im Bundestag &#124; Zeit Online |newspaper=Die Zeit|date=24 October 2017|access-date=14 September 2019 |last1=Biermann |first1=Kai |last2=Geisler |first2=Astrid |last3=Holzinger |first3=Christina |last4=Middelhoff |first4=Paul |last5=Polke-Majewski |first5=Karsten |last6=Steffen |first6=Tilman }}</ref> He has participated in [[Pegida]] demonstrations.<ref>{{cite book|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=svtNEAAAQBAJ&pg=PA119|title=The Radical Right During Crisis: CARR Yearbook 2020/2021|first=Eviane|last=Leidig|publisher=ibidem|year=2021|page=119|isbn=9783838215761}}</ref>

Heßenkemper denies the [[scientific consensus on climate change]].<ref name="youtube">{{cite web|url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IO-DoVYTtFc|title=12.8.2019: Heiko Hessenkemper über Zeitsprünge, Grünen-Zitate und die bevorstehende Sachsenwahl|website=YouTube|access-date=14 September 2019}}</ref> Heßenkemper has stated that he will not be a candidate in the [[2021 German federal election]].<ref>[https://www.saechsische.de/doebeln/muldaerin-will-fuer-afd-in-den-bundestag-mittelsachsen-wahl-5298823.html Saechsische.de: Muldaerin will für AfD in den Bundestag  (german)], October 2020</ref> He left AfD in June 2021, three months before the [[2021 German federal election|2021 federal election]].<ref>{{Cite news |date=30 June 2021 |title=AfD: Bundestagsabgeordnete Hollnagel und Hessenkemper treten aus Partei aus |language=de |work=Der Spiegel |url=https://www.spiegel.de/politik/deutschland/afd-bundestagsabgeordnete-bruno-hollnagel-und-heiko-hessenkemper-treten-aus-partei-aus-a-48712cf3-2f3c-4e8b-bb78-43022b421933 |access-date=20 May 2022 |issn=2195-1349}}</ref>
